newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco Chicago unleaded diffs plunge on Clark.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco Chicago unleaded diffs plunge on Clark.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials fell sharply Friday on a court decision allowing a key regional refinery to restart two processing units idled since a fire in mid-October, traders said.

Chicago unleaded gasoline differentials lost two cents a gallon with no deals heard done after an Illinois court ruled against a suit by state regulators seeking to idle Clark Refining and Marketing Co's 80,515 barrel per day Blue Island, Ill., refinery following the October 19 explosion.
Illinois regulators had asked the court to shut the entire refinery because of lingering safety concerns.
"Basis lost at least two cents," one Chicago trader said.
Buyers in Chicago have remained on the sidelines following the midday court decision, in part because the sliding differentials were offset by a 1.47 cent gain in front-month gasoline futures.
"I'm short, but I can live with it right now," another trader said.
Chicago unleaded was talked 6.75/7.0 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded for prompt deliveries, and 4.75/5.0 cents cents over the print for later deliveries.
Group Three unleaded eased to 4.0/4.25 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and remained 1.75/2.0 cents over for later deliveries.
Prompt low sulphur diesel was bid 3.50 cents a gallon over NYMEX December heating oil in Chicago and 4.50 cents over the print in Group Three, traders said
High sulphur diesel was talked 1.75 cents a gallon over the print in Chicago and 3.50 cents over the print in Group Three.
Jet/kero was unchanged late in the day, with prices tracking a two cent a gallon rise in front-month heating oil futures.
